input: unchanged exact-PTS canonical frontend, shared YOLOv8x and ViTPose COCO17
own_model: DSTE/J1/G0; hash-verified existing predictions and existing quality rejections
comparator: author PySKL PoseC3D SlowOnly-R50 NTU60 xsub joint
posec3d_test: unmodified official test pipeline: Uniform48 x10, seed255, compact,64x64,sigma0.6,confidence,flip,mean20softmax
decision: original multiclass argmax mapped to binary
quality: own original gate; PoseC3D no 3D gate, zero-score missing poses retained; all failures counted

evaluation.event: rising edge at window endpoint; early0.5/late3; one-to-one; refractory0
evaluation.video: any fall argmax window; max fall score for AP
evaluation.paired_bootstrap: 10000 video draws per dataset, seed20261003; exploratory 95% percentile CI

limitations: different source training and label spaces
shared ViTPose replaces comparator training HRNet input
fixed64 sliding windows replace whole-action clips
existing target diagnostic exposure; 2/1/2 held-out subjects, clustered-video bootstrap is descriptive
